description: Nordic nRF52840 TWIM0 (I2C Master with EasyDMA), peripheral 0. Imported via `mununu codesign import-svd` from the upstream nrfx SVD at commit 0883a272c34004697dd56dfa44f6e2d0f8705689 (bsp/stable/mdk/nrf52840.svd), BSD-3-Clause. SOUNDNESS: the upstream importer aborts on Nordic's <cluster> vendor-extension (e.g. peripheral ACL), so the importer was run against a hand-sliced SVD containing only the TWIM0 <peripheral> block. The sliced source is checked in at upstream/nrf52840.svd and the slicing transcript is documented in upstream/ATTRIBUTION.md. Per-field sv_signal and c_accessor mappings were post-author authored against the Nordic nRF52840 Product Specification §6.30 (TWIM) and the nrfx_twim.c HAL accessor conventions. The TXD and RXD EasyDMA cluster registers (TXD.PTR/MAXCNT/AMOUNT, RXD.PTR/MAXCNT/AMOUNT) are described inside <cluster> elements in the upstream SVD; the importer skips clusters silently. Those registers were added by hand here with the standard offsets from §6.30 of the nRF52840 Product Specification (0x534/0x544 base for RXD/TXD respectively). The TXD.PTR-before-TASKS_STARTTX ordering relation that the property pack exercises requires these registers to exist as labels.
